REAL EXPERIENCE MODELとは・・・
＜“体験”というガンプラにおける新たな領域への挑戦。＞
“駆動機構”“劇中サウンド”“発光演出”“大型スケール”これらの組み合わせにより、
劇中シーンを現実世界で体感する。それは、まだ誰も知らないガンプラ新体験。

en: ★ Please see the special page for details (https://bandai-hobby.net/site/auto_trans/)★
- It's a new Gunpla experience that no one knows about yet.
REAL EXPERIENCE MODEL RX-0 Unicorn Gundam (AUTO-TRANS edition) -
What is REAL EXPERIENCE MODEL?
<Gunpla's challenge to a new area of ​​"experience." ＞
The combination of “drive mechanism,” “sound in the play,” “light-emitting production,” and “large scale” enables
Experience the scenes from the movie in the real world. It's a new Gunpla experience that no one knows about yet.
● Kit contents: Drive light emitting unit / exterior parts
● Product size: Total height approx. 40cm
●Package: Delivered with original design box art
★★ Purchase benefits ★★
A display board inspired by the world of "Mobile Suit Gundam UC" is included. (made of paper)
*About the driving light emitting unit
▼Power source: Uses 6 AA alkaline batteries (sold separately). Continuous playback time approximately 2 hours. (*Estimated when using commercially available alkaline batteries.)
▼Sound: The volume can be adjusted by key operation, so you can enjoy it at high volume. Output: 1000mW
▼Extensibility: Equipped with a 3.5φ stereo mini jack that can be connected to external speakers (sold separately).
*The audio component is monaural. When outputting externally, the same sound is output for both L and R.
Non-Scale Assembly type plastic model
Target age: 15 years old or older
Main product material: ABS/POM
*This product is an assembly type plastic model that combines the assembled driving light emitting unit and exterior parts.
*Requires 6 AA alkaline batteries (sold separately) for operation.
*No adhesive is used in the assembly
*The finished product in the photo is a prototype that is still under development. There may be slight differences from the actual product.
*Speakers shown in the image are sold separately.
(remarks)
・This product cannot be purchased at stores that carry plastic models.
・This product may be sold in other projects or overseas.
